description: This PHP source file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoopener, which adds rel="noopener" to HTML link attributes with target attributes to prevent security issues related to window targeting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoopener
classes.description: A class that ensures rel="noopener" is added to links that open in new windows or tabs, for security improvements.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Adds 'noopener' to the 'rel' attribute of links with a 'target' attribute if not already present.
